correctness.rationale: The proof scales the consistent mass and stiffness matrices exactly; establishes positivity via a nonsingular \(M\)-matrix for \(r\ge1/6\); handles \(n=3\) by exact eigenvalues; and proves a strictly negative distance-two coefficient for every \(n\ge4\) and \(0<r<1/6\) using the periodic Green function. The finite script is supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: The exact cutoff is a useful structure-preserving timestep rule for a natural finite-element discretization of the heat equation. It explains a genuine small-step positivity failure, rules out all sub-threshold positive windows for every cycle size \(n\ge4\), and isolates the minimal three-node exception with an analytic reason.
